messages:
Maya R: Quick sync on the HarborLogix POC — they want a 3-week pilot to prove two things: (A) ops claim triage assistant that suggests routing + severity + canned responses, (B) port ETA summarization that turns raw logs and ETA feeds into structured updates for their UI. Need to align on endpoints, prompts/evals, SLOs, and infra (hosted vs dedicated).

Oliver T: Got it. Who's owning the prompt design and eval harness?

Samir P: I can take prompts/evals. Proposal: week1 gather prompt set + golden labels, week2 implement model + integration, week3 run live evals with sampled traffic and user feedback.

Jess L: Security checklist — they require SOC2 + VPC peering option and field-level encryption for PII. Also need answers for data retention and redaction.

Maya R: Good call. For infra decision, they may need Dedicated for throughput and compliance, but start Hosted with strict retention config for speed. If ev al shows latency problems, move to Dedicated.

Oliver T: Can we define success criteria in measurable terms? E.g., triage: suggestion accuracy >= 78% top-1, mean time to suggestion < 400ms (95th perc), and human accept rate >= 60% after 2 weeks. ETA summarization: timestamped updates with median error < 12 minutes and structured parsing F1 > 0.82.

Samir P: Agreed. For prompts, we'll create two suites: "ops-assist" (50 canonical tickets + 200 augmentations) and "eta-parser" (100 log samples + edge cases). Eval harness will run offline metrics (accuracy/F1/latency) and online A/B for human accept rate.

Maya R: Also include cost SLO: target per-100k token spend under their threshold — they gave target $X (we'll fill once pricing team confirms). Need a simple cost simulation for hosted vs dedicated.

Jess L: Security Eng, can you confirm if VPC peering + KMS is available for a 3-week POC? They flagged regulatory audits.

Security Eng: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS is available for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted we can offer encrypted-at-rest with our KMS and transient logs (30d) — will need a signed DPA for stricter retention. I can draft the security appendix.

Samir P: Example API contract for the triage endpoint (MVP):
```
POST /v1/poc/harborlogix/triage
{
  "ticket_text": "<raw ops ticket text>",
  "metadata": {"source":"email","priority_hint":"low"}
}
response:
{
  "predictions": [{"route":"claims_queue","confidence":0.84,"snippet":"Suggest escalate to customs team"}],
  "latency_ms": 120
}
```
We'll instrument latency_ms and confidence thresholds.

Oliver T: Nice. For ETA parser endpoint: return structured JSON with fields: port_id, eta_iso, delay_minutes, confidence, raw_extraction. Need schema examples.

Maya R: Prioritization for MVP: 1) triage single-turn suggestions (highest business impact), 2) ETA structured parsing (medium), 3) canned reply generator (stretch). Keep rollout simple: webhooks to their ops UI + dashboard.

Samir P: I'll prepare prompt templates, golden label spreadsheet, and an eval runner (pytest + small harness). Will seed with 150 samples for week1.

Jess L: I'll collect the security questionnaire items they sent and flag any blockers. If they insist on on-prem for the POC that's a hard stop — need exec escalation.

Maya R: Pricing question: show two options in the proposal: quick-hosted POC estimate (3 weeks, standard capacity) and Dedicated POC estimate (capacity + peering + KMS). Sales needs both numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Presales Bot: New opportunity created: OPP-4382 HarborLogix — POC 3w. Owners: Maya R, Samir P. Due: 2025-11-21.

Oliver T: Action items: Samir = prompts/evals + example schemas, Jess = security questionnaire + DPA status, Maya = pricing coords with finance, I'll draft integration checklist and minimal infra diagram. We'll meet 24hrs after Samir posts the prompt set.

Maya R: Thanks — I'll update the deal notes and add the POC timeline to the customer workspace. Everyone drop quick blockers here.

Samir P: Blocker: need anonymized sample tickets and port logs from HarborLogix. I requested them in the kickoff email — awaiting.

Jess L: Blocker: legal needs a copy of their DPA template to compare. Please ask them to share.

Oliver T: I'll send a one-page scope doc by EOD with the endpoints, SLO table and success metrics.

Maya R: Perfect. :thumbsup:
